metadata.Name: PIQA
metadata.Description: This dataset focuses on physical commonsense reasoning, presenting questions requiring understanding of everyday physical interactions. It's designed to challenge language models by testing their ability to reason about how objects behave in the real world.
metadata.Paper Title: PIQA: Reasoning about Physical Commonsense in Natural Language
Affiliations: Paul G. Allen School for Computer Science and Engineering, University of Washington
